title: PvE healers
description: Five healers, one letter each, for level-60 dungeons and the December raids. Absorb, single-target, and raid healing are different jobs.
basis: L60 projection from beta build 1.60.1.70124 and the five healer spec files. Icy Veins' Holy Priest and Restoration Shaman guides (level-20 beta) set the relative jobs. No raid log exists.

entries.note: The Discipline file says bring it to every dungeon. Shield, Penance, Divine Aegis. The absorb healer.
The file's single-target healer, plus the buff kit. Light's Vigil is the new answer to spread damage.
Riptide into Chain Heal, Mana Tide for the group. Icy Veins calls it an excellent dungeon healer.
Wild Growth and Swiftmend. The file rates the HoTs and also notes no absorb and a thinner utility kit.
Prayer of Mending when damage is spread. Icy Veins says Discipline outshines it on single-target. The file agrees.
